_about: Lesson pieces for STEM Lesson Gallery. A lesson = one mission + one theme skin + one featured person. 12 missions x 5 themes = 60 lessons. Source: STEM Lesson Generator - Lesson Library Draft.

people.name: Emily Warren Roebling
people.fact: Led the day-to-day work on the Brooklyn Bridge after her husband fell ill, and was the first person to cross it when it opened in 1883.

people.name: Archie Alexander
people.fact: A Black engineer whose firm designed bridges and highways, including the Tidal Basin Bridge and the Whitehurst Freeway in Washington, D.C.

people.name: Othmar Ammann
people.fact: Swiss-American engineer behind New York's George Washington Bridge and Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge.

people.name: George Ferris
people.fact: A Pittsburgh bridge engineer who invented the Ferris wheel for the 1893 World's Fair in Chicago.

people.name: Zaha Hadid
people.fact: Iraqi-British architect who designed the wave-shaped Sheikh Zayed Bridge in Abu Dhabi, and the first woman to win the Pritzker Prize.

people.name: Fazlur Rahman Khan
people.fact: Bangladeshi-American engineer who invented the 'tube' system that let skyscrapers like Chicago's Willis Tower rise so tall.

people.name: I. M. Pei
people.fact: Chinese-American architect who designed the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong and the glass pyramid at the Louvre.

people.name: Norma Merrick Sklarek
people.fact: The first Black woman licensed as an architect in New York and California. She helped lead Terminal One at Los Angeles International Airport.

people.name: Gustave Eiffel
people.fact: His company built the Eiffel Tower in 1889 and designed the iron skeleton inside the Statue of Liberty.

people.name: Zaha Hadid
people.fact: Iraqi-British architect known for curving towers and buildings that look like they are moving.

people.name: Percy Julian
people.fact: Made medicines from soybeans and invented a firefighting foam used by the U.S. Navy.

people.name: Alice Ball
people.fact: Developed the first effective injectable treatment for leprosy, at age 23.

people.name: Mae Jemison
people.fact: Became the first African American woman in space in 1992, aboard the Space Shuttle Endeavour.

people.name: Chien-Shiung Wu
people.fact: Her careful 1956 experiment proved that a 'law' of physics everyone believed was wrong.

people.name: Mario Molina
people.fact: Mexican chemist who showed that certain sprays were damaging Earth's ozone layer, and won the Nobel Prize in 1995.

people.name: Rachel Carson
people.fact: Grew up in Springdale, near Pittsburgh. Her book Silent Spring helped start the modern environmental movement.

people.name: Katherine Johnson
people.fact: Calculated the flight paths that got NASA astronauts into orbit and safely home.

missions.title: Rescue the Stranded Animals
missions.hook: Stuffed animals are stuck on an "island" across a paper river full of cardboard sharks. The counselor reads a quick rescue message from the animals.
missions.mission: Build a popsicle-stick and tape bridge so the animals can cross.
missions.showdown: Each team walks a stuffed animal across while everyone counts down. Bonus: can it carry two animals?
talkback: What made your bridge strong?
What would you change next time?

missions.title: Monster Truck Crossing
missions.hook: Show a short video of a monster truck smashing over obstacles. "Your bridge is next."
missions.mission: Build a straw or craft-stick bridge across a gap between two desks.
missions.showdown: Load toy trucks or a cup of pennies until it collapses. Leaderboard on the whiteboard for most weight held.
talkback: Where did your bridge break first, and why there?
Which design on the leaderboard would you copy?

missions.title: Bridge Tycoon
missions.hook: Slow-motion clip of the Tacoma Narrows Bridge twisting and falling. "Don't be that engineer."
missions.mission: Teams get fake money to buy sticks, tape and string from a camp "store," then design the best bridge for the price.
missions.showdown: Live load test with a bucket and sand or weights. Winner = most weight per dollar spent. Film the collapse in slow motion on a phone.
talkback: Was the strongest bridge also the best value?
What would you buy differently with the same budget?

missions.title: City Contract Pitch
missions.hook: Pittsburgh is the City of Bridges. Teams are engineering firms competing for a contract.
missions.mission: Sketch a design, predict how much weight it holds, then build it.
missions.showdown: Quick 1-minute pitch, then the load test. Closest prediction and strongest bridge both win prizes.
talkback: How close was your prediction, and what threw it off?
What would a real city ask that we skipped?

missions.title: Tallest Tower Party
missions.hook: Show a picture of the tallest building in the world next to a picture of a giraffe. "Can we build taller than a giraffe's knee?"
missions.mission: Build towers with paper cups, blocks, or marshmallows and toothpicks.
missions.showdown: The counselor knocks them down with a soft-ball "wrecking ball" at the end, and kids cheer for the last tower standing.
talkback: Why did the last tower stay up?
Is a wide bottom or a tall top more important?

missions.title: Marshmallow Mountain
missions.hook: "A marshmallow wants to see the view from the top." Timer on the big screen.
missions.mission: Spaghetti, tape and string tower with a marshmallow on top, 18 minutes.
missions.showdown: Measure live with a tape measure while the room counts. Tallest standing tower wins.
talkback: When did you put the marshmallow on, and did that matter?
What shape held the most height?

missions.title: Earthquake City
missions.hook: Video of a shake table test on a real skyscraper model.
missions.mission: Build a straw or index-card tower that must hold a small toy "family" on top.
missions.showdown: Earthquake time: a shake table (tray on tennis balls) cranked up level by level. Fan for a hurricane round.
talkback: Which level of shaking broke the most towers?
How do real buildings stay up in earthquakes?

missions.title: Skyline Challenge
missions.hook: Show the Eiffel Tower and Burj Khalifa side by side. What makes each one stand?
missions.mission: Hit a target height with limited materials, and the tower must survive a wind test.
missions.showdown: Fan wind test plus a quick team pitch of their design idea.
materials: Limited kit per team (straws, cards, tape)
talkback: What tradeoff did you make between height and strength?
Which real tower inspired your design?

missions.title: Elephant Toothpaste
missions.hook: "Have you ever seen an elephant brush its teeth?" Show a picture of a giant elephant.
missions.mission: Counselor-led foam explosion with kid-safe ingredients (yeast, dish soap, low-strength peroxide). Kids add food coloring and predict how high it goes.
missions.showdown: Countdown, then foam eruption. Kids touch the warm foam and say what they noticed.
talkback: Why do you think the foam felt warm?
Was your guess too high or too low?

missions.title: Egg Drop Rescue
missions.hook: Video of a Mars rover landing. "Your egg is the astronaut."
missions.mission: Build a lander with straws, paper, cups and tape to protect a raw egg.
missions.showdown: Drop from a ladder or stairwell with the whole group watching. Crack check live.
talkback: What slowed your egg down or softened the landing?
How is this like landing on Mars?

missions.title: Color-Changing Mystery
missions.hook: The counselor pours "water" into cups and it turns pink, purple and green like magic.
missions.mission: Make red cabbage juice and test mystery liquids to figure out the trick.
missions.showdown: Teams race to solve the "mystery potion" challenge first.
talkback: What do the colors tell you about each liquid?
Where else do acids and bases show up in your day?

missions.title: Mythbusters Lab
missions.hook: Clip of a famous myth: does Mentos in soda really explode?
missions.mission: Teams pick a myth and design a fair test with a control and repeat trials.
missions.showdown: Run the tests outside and vote: busted, plausible or confirmed.
talkback: What made your test fair?
How many trials would convince a skeptic?

sports.title: Mascots Stranded Before Kickoff
sports.hook: The team mascots are stuck on an island before the big game, and cardboard sharks are circling. Build a bridge so they make it to kickoff.

music.title: Get the Band to the Stage
music.hook: The stuffed-animal band is stuck across the river and the concert starts soon. Build a bridge to get the band on stage.

gaming.title: Level 1: Animal Rescue
gaming.hook: Your stuffed-animal players spawned on an island surrounded by shark enemies. Build a bridge to clear level one.

neighborhood.title: A Bridge Home
neighborhood.hook: Pittsburgh is full of bridges, and today our stuffed animals need one more to get home across the river.

heroes.title: Sidekick Rescue
heroes.hook: The heroes' animal sidekicks are trapped on an island by cardboard sharks. The heroes need a bridge, fast.

sports.title: Team Bus Crossing
sports.hook: The team bus has to cross the river to make the championship. Your bridge has to hold the whole team.

music.title: Tour Bus Crossing
music.hook: The tour bus is packed with speakers and the show is across the gap. Will your bridge hold the gear?

gaming.title: Clear the Level
gaming.hook: Real-life level: the only way to the next stage is across your bridge. Load it until it breaks.

neighborhood.title: Hill District Connector
neighborhood.hook: Connect two blocks in the Hill District with a bridge strong enough for buses and delivery trucks.

heroes.title: Rescue Truck Crossing
heroes.hook: A villain weakened the city bridge. Build a new one strong enough for the rescue trucks.

sports.title: Stadium Bridge Tycoon
sports.hook: The city wants a walking bridge to the new stadium. You get a budget. Most strength per dollar wins the deal.

music.title: Festival Bridge Tycoon
music.hook: A music festival needs a bridge over the creek to the main stage. Crowds are heavy, so spend your budget wisely.

gaming.title: Bridge Tycoon: High Score
gaming.hook: Like a building sim, but real. Buy parts from the store, build, and beat the high score for weight per dollar.

neighborhood.title: Three Rivers Tycoon
neighborhood.hook: Pittsburgh sits where three rivers meet, so bridges are big business. Win the contract with the best bridge for the price.

heroes.title: Hero Budget Build
heroes.hook: The hero team's funding just got cut. Build the strongest bridge you can on a tight budget before the villain strikes.

sports.title: Stadium Contract Pitch
sports.hook: Your firm is bidding to build the bridge fans will cross on game day. Pitch it, predict it, prove it.

music.title: Amphitheater Contract Pitch
music.hook: A new outdoor concert venue needs an entrance bridge. Pitch your design to the venue's board.

gaming.title: Studio Pitch: Build the Map
gaming.hook: A game studio wants a real bridge model for its next open-world map. Pitch the design, then stress-test it.

neighborhood.title: City of Bridges Contract
neighborhood.hook: Pittsburgh is the City of Bridges. Your firm is competing for the contract to reconnect the Hill District to downtown.

heroes.title: Rebuild the City
heroes.hook: After the big battle, the city needs a new bridge. Hero-backed engineering firms pitch their designs to the mayor.

sports.title: Mini Hoop Tower
sports.hook: Can we build a tower tall enough to hold a mini basketball hoop? Taller than a giraffe's knee?

music.title: Speaker Stack Party
music.hook: Every concert needs a tall stack of speakers. Build yours before the dance party starts.

gaming.title: Block Tower Challenge
gaming.hook: Build like your favorite block game, but with real cups and blocks. Can it survive the wrecking ball?

neighborhood.title: Build Our Skyline
neighborhood.hook: Look at the tall buildings in downtown Pittsburgh. Can we build our own skyline right here in the room?

heroes.title: Hero Lookout Tower
heroes.hook: Heroes need a tall lookout to spot trouble. Build it before the wrecking-ball villain attacks.

sports.title: Marshmallow Podium
sports.hook: The marshmallow just won gold and wants the highest podium ever. 18 minutes on the clock.

music.title: Top of the Charts
music.hook: The marshmallow wants to hit number one. Get it as high as possible in 18 minutes.

gaming.title: High Score Tower
gaming.hook: Your marshmallow avatar needs max height for the high score. The timer is on the big screen.

neighborhood.title: Mount Washington View
neighborhood.hook: From Mount Washington you can see all of downtown Pittsburgh. Give the marshmallow its own lookout.

heroes.title: Rooftop Hero
heroes.hook: Every hero needs a rooftop pose. Get the marshmallow hero as high as you can in 18 minutes.

sports.title: Arena Shake Test
sports.hook: When a stadium crowd jumps, the building moves. Keep the fans on top of your tower safe through every shake level.

music.title: Bass Drop Tower
music.hook: Build the tallest speaker tower that survives the bass drop. The shake table is the subwoofer.

gaming.title: Boss Tower
gaming.hook: Boss fight: your tower must survive three earthquake levels, each harder than the last.

neighborhood.title: Steel City Shake Test
neighborhood.hook: Pittsburgh is the Steel City. Prove your tower is just as tough when the ground starts shaking.

heroes.title: Villain Quake Defense
heroes.hook: A villain's quake machine is shaking the city. Protect the toy family on top of your tower.

sports.title: Stadium Light Towers
sports.hook: Night games need light towers that stand up to wind. Hit the target height, survive the fan, and pitch your design.

music.title: Festival Stage Tower
music.hook: Outdoor festivals need towers for lights and speakers that won't blow over. Design one and pitch it.

gaming.title: Real-World Build Mode
gaming.hook: No cheat codes: hit the height target with limited materials and survive the wind test.

neighborhood.title: New Pittsburgh Landmark
neighborhood.hook: Design a new landmark tower for Pittsburgh that could stand next to the best of the skyline.

heroes.title: Hero Headquarters
heroes.hook: Build a hero headquarters that survives a villain attack. The villain's weapon: a very big fan.

sports.title: Victory Foam
sports.hook: When a team wins, the celebration explodes. Let's make a victory foam eruption.

music.title: Foam Drop
music.hook: Count down like the beat before the drop, then watch the foam explode.

gaming.title: Power-Up Potion
gaming.hook: Mix the power-up potion and watch it level up right out of the bottle.

neighborhood.title: Zoo Elephant Toothpaste
neighborhood.hook: Pittsburgh's zoo has elephants. How would one brush its giant teeth?

heroes.title: Power-Up Eruption
heroes.hook: Every hero has a power-up moment. Today ours is a giant foam eruption.

sports.title: Trophy Egg Drop
sports.hook: Protect the star player's "trophy egg" from a big drop. One crack and the season's over.

music.title: Rock Star Entrance
music.hook: The egg is a rock star making a big entrance from above the stage. Land it without a crack.

gaming.title: One Life Left
gaming.hook: Your egg has one life and no respawns. Build a lander that gets it down safe.

neighborhood.title: Incline Egg Drop
neighborhood.hook: Pittsburgh's inclines carry riders safely down Mount Washington. Your lander has to do the same for an egg.

heroes.title: Hero Landing
heroes.hook: Every hero lands from high up. Make sure your egg hero sticks the landing.

sports.title: Sports Drink Lab
sports.hook: Which sports drinks are acids? Test them with cabbage juice and crack the case.

music.title: Light Show Potions
music.hook: Make every cup a different color, like a concert light show. Then figure out the trick.

gaming.title: Potion Lab
gaming.hook: Mix colors to unlock the next level. Only teams who crack the potion code advance.

neighborhood.title: Local Water Lab
neighborhood.hook: Test which local waters and drinks are acids or bases. What's really in what we drink?

heroes.title: Villain's Mystery Potions
heroes.hook: A villain swapped the city's drinks with mystery potions. Use cabbage juice to find out which are which.

sports.title: Sports Myths Tested
sports.hook: Do new sneakers really make you jump higher? Pick a sports myth and test it fairly.

music.title: Music Myths Tested
music.hook: Does music help plants grow? Pick a music myth and design a fair test.

gaming.title: Gaming Myths Tested
gaming.hook: Does blowing on a game cartridge actually fix it? Pick a gaming myth and test it.

neighborhood.title: Neighborhood Myths Tested
neighborhood.hook: Everyone has heard a local claim, like which store's soda fizzes the most. Pick one and test it like a scientist.

heroes.title: Superpower Science
heroes.hook: Could a hero really do that? Pick a movie-stunt myth and test the science at small scale.
